not_built.name: Router
not_built.what: A whitelist APR router with an optimal-switching boundary — move only when the yield delta exceeds gas plus slippage — deployed through the BNB Agent Studio CLI as the native-citizenship proof.
not_built.why: Never started. The three agents that exist share one replay engine and one cost model; Router is the only one of the four that would have needed a second venue model, and it was cut rather than faked.
